principles: Only verified production server gate_decision receipts can satisfy lifecycle Authority gates.
Local, shadow, and diagnostic host paths must remain truthful and non-authoritative.
Gate consumption must be idempotent and derived, not caller supplied.
Do not expand scope beyond receipt proof verification, writer, lifecycle consumption, and truthful status output.
drivers: The CLI must verify proof bundles from Server story B-f053 before writing production receipt refs.
Existing local workflow must remain usable unless Authority enforce mode is configured.
TEST should prove the consumption path before DONE is made stricter.

options.name: verify-write-consume-staged
pros: Separates proof verification, receipt-ref writing, TEST consumption, DONE policy, and status output into testable layers.
Allows fixture-based CLI development while the server proof endpoint lands.
Preserves fail-closed enforce behavior without breaking local/shadow defaults.
cons: Requires several small modules and smoke tasks.
DONE enforcement must wait for TEST consumption to stabilize.

options.name: wire-gates-first
pros: Could surface missing proof fields early.
cons: Would force gates to consume incomplete or fixture-only data.
Risks confusing readiness with verified authority and violating host-neutral boundary.

options.name: status-only-first
cons: Does not close the correctness gap because verified receipts still are not written or consumed.
Could create a polished surface without real authority semantics.

rationale: The staged path is the smallest correctness-preserving implementation: verify proof first, write structured refs second, consume in TEST before DONE, then render status facts without overclaiming.

preMortem.scenario: CLI accepts a local-test or default server key as production authority.
preMortem.trigger: Verifier checks signature but ignores key profile or pinned digest policy.
preMortem.consequence: A local dev server could satisfy production gates incorrectly.
preMortem.mitigation: Classify cryptographically valid local-test keys as server-receipt-local-test and test that no production ref is written.

preMortem.scenario: Gate retry appends duplicate consumption events.
preMortem.trigger: Consumption uses append-only behavior without a stable consumerDecisionId.
preMortem.consequence: A retried validate or DONE could double-count evidence or confuse audit history.
preMortem.mitigation: Add idempotent consume-if-not-present semantics and smoke tests for repeated gate runs.

preMortem.scenario: Authority enforcement breaks existing local stories by default.
preMortem.trigger: Gate adapter treats missing receipt refs as hard failures even when policy is local or shadow.
preMortem.consequence: Existing local workflow becomes unusable and users see unrelated blocks.
preMortem.mitigation: Default to local/shadow diagnostic behavior; fail closed only when Authority-backed evidence is explicitly required.

preMortem.scenario: DONE consumes a stale TEST receipt after material changes.
preMortem.trigger: DONE gate does not re-check current head/material or phase coverage policy.
preMortem.consequence: ProductionDone could be derived from an obsolete decision.
preMortem.mitigation: Recompute gate context immediately before DONE and require a distinct DONE receipt unless policy explicitly allows TEST coverage.
